environment.description: Same application deployed on identical EC2 infrastructure. ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL. The WebACL contains three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) Priority 100 - AWS managed rule group 'AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet' with all rules in COUNT mode except 'SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING' which is in default BLOCK action, (2) Priority 200 - Custom rule group 'query-string-entropy-filter' with a single regex rule matching request query strings against pattern `[^a-zA-Z0-9@._%+\-\s]{2,}` with BLOCK action and text/plain custom response body, (3) Priority 300 - AWS managed rule group 'AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet' in COUNT mode. WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics enabled for sampled requests on all rules.

waf_rule_priority_100.name: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet
waf_rule_priority_100.mode: COUNT (all rules except SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING which is BLOCK)
waf_rule_priority_100.note: SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING blocks query strings over 2048 bytes
